problem: 'Listen for a progressive-tense verb' is a made-up cue; a How answer can be in any tense (We'll switch carriers, By renegotiating...)
fix: How 問方法 → 聽具體作法；刪掉 ship、set off 等音近字

problem: 'set off' is not a sense of any word in the question; it only sounds like 'offset', so 一字多義 is the wrong label
The quoted phrase 'By the end of week' is ungrammatical; it must be 'by the end of the week' (or business shorthand 'by end of week')
fix: By the end of the week 是期限，不是原因

problem: The pattern 'Isn't supposed to' drops the subject, a typical Chinese-influenced error; the question form is 'Isn't [the audit] supposed to'
fix: Isn't…supposed to 確認預定；回延期＝不是週一

problem: The distractor is built on 'closes' echoing 'disclose', so it is a sound trap, not a plain non-sequitur
The line misses that 'closes' sounds like 'disclose' in the question, which is what makes the option tempting
fix: closes 與 disclose 發音相近，講營業時間

problem: 'station' echoes 'workstation' in the question; the trap is the repeated sound, not a plain non-sequitur
The line misses the 'station' / 'workstation' echo that the distractor relies on
fix: station 是 workstation 的一部分，講火車站

problem: 'line' is not a separate sense of a word in the question, only part of 'timeline' (the sibling 'time' option is labelled 重複字), so 一字多義 is wrong
'Isn't mandatory' drops the dummy subject 'it', reinforcing the common learner error 'Is necessary to...'
fix: Isn't it mandatory 確認規定；Yes＋補充細節
